steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: If you offer financing through a lender, you can put their link in front of your clients.

steps.caption: Financing links
steps.narration: In Settings, at the end of Payments, find Financing links.

steps.caption: The label
steps.narration: Type the words your client will see.

steps.caption: The lender's link
steps.narration: Then paste the link your lender gave you.

steps.caption: Primary
steps.narration: It is saved and marked Primary. The primary link is the one your clients see.

steps.caption: Up to ten links
steps.narration: You can keep up to ten links, and choose which one is primary.

steps.caption: The client's portal
steps.narration: Now your client's screen. This is their portal.

steps.caption: Financing in the portal
steps.narration: Under Financing, they find your link, with an Apply button.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: It is on the estimate too. They open the one you sent.

steps.caption: Financing available
steps.narration: The estimate is marked Financing available.

steps.caption: Finance this project
steps.narration: And further down is the link itself: Finance this project.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back on your screen, in Settings.

steps.caption: Financing interest alert
steps.narration: Under Notifications, Financing interest alerts you when a client clicks the financing option.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Financing links are in Settings, near the bottom of the left menu.

youtube.title: How to offer financing on your estimates | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Add your lender's link in ConstructHUB CRM Settings and your clients see a financing option in their portal and on your estimates. You are alerted when a client clicks it. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client and an example link.
